svg.aria-label: DeltaQuant agentic trading system: external services feed a deterministic market-data pipeline and a four-agent LangGraph decision core; the risk-approved output reaches an execution layer, while durable memory (Postgres, AgentMemoryDB, the local paper engine) records every trade and feeds lessons back into the pipeline.
svg.text: DhanHQ is the sole market-data and broker source — no YFinance fallback. Deterministic screening and a deterministic risk gate bound what the LLM core ever sees or executes.
Runs only after support agents (News · Sentiment · Prediction) enrich the state
The single blackboard every node reads and writes — market data, indicators, signals, decisions
